subject: CS480
filterSummary: Successfully selected 9 out of 10 possible videos covering key project cost and financial management topics. The English selections are strong, with high-view, relevant content for all topics. The Arabic selections are also strong for most topics, though one required using the low-view exception rule due to a lack of high-reach candidates. One topic, Project Portfolio Financial Management, had no suitable Arabic candidates as all videos were either irrelevant or focused on financial securities instead of projects.
